# Layergram 2.0.2 — Identity startup reliability

Layergram 2.0.2 fixes an identity-loading race that could make an existing
installation look as if it had no identity. The app now waits for secure
identity storage to finish loading before deciding whether to show onboarding
or the create-identity action.

The release now:

- keeps startup and My Identity in an explicit loading state until the identity
  result is known;
- shows a recoverable error with Retry when secure identity storage cannot be
  read, instead of presenting a misleading create action;
- offers Create identity only after the app has confirmed that no identity is
  stored;
- keeps the contact-link import controls reachable above the on-screen keyboard
  on tablet layouts; and
- adds regression coverage for loading, storage errors, retry, startup routing,
  and keyboard-constrained contact import.

Android open-source APKs remain signed with Layergram's dedicated direct-APK
certificate. Verify every download against the SHA-256 values published with
the release and on the Layergram website.
